svg.title: 2025-2026: 2,947 contributions
svg.desc: An isometric city of GitHub contributions: one tower per day, its height the contributions of that day, and one river per run of quiet weeks, 2025-11-23 to 2026-11-28, 53 weeks. 2,947 contributions on 74 active days, 2025-11-23 to 2026-11-28 · longest streak 14 days to 2026-10-19 · busiest month October 2026 (1,376)
svg.text: Each tower is one day, its height the contributions that day; each river a run of quiet weeks.
